summary: FG Nexus Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 17, 2026 subscription agreement to buy 1,818,182 FGC common shares at $5.50 per share, or $10,000,001 cash, closing September 21, 2026. FGC is a private North Carolina manufactured-housing REIT with 96 communities and 4,000-plus home sites. Because Chairman/CEO Kyle Cerminara also leads FGC, a special committee of independent directors and an independent financial advisor reviewed and recommended the related-party deal before board approval. Watch for valuation fairness challenges, disclosure of the advisor and FGC financials, and any minority-holder or governance fallout.
